name: Santa Clara Instructor/Lifeguard (as-needed, ages 16+)
org: City of Santa Clara Parks & Recreation
what_you_do: Teach swim classes at all levels and guard swimmers at a city pool. You also help keep the pool and deck clean and safe.
who_can_apply: At least 16 when you apply and done with 10th grade (or the same level). You need an American Red Cross Lifeguard certificate, plus a Red Cross Water Safety Instructor certificate or the City of Santa Clara Learn To Swim Instruction Program. You can apply while you are still getting them.
duration: As-needed, part-time, up to 999 hours a year.
deadline_text: Opened Mar 16, 2026. No closing date is shown on the posting.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the City of Santa Clara job board (governmentjobs.com) and attach your certificates if you have them. The city contacts only the applicants who best fit current openings.
notes: Fingerprints and a TB test are required. A work permit is needed at hire if you are under 18 and have not finished high school. The posting does not say which city pools are hiring, so ask when you apply.
